facts.fact: A Boston Consulting Group report, as cited by the page, found agencies and advertisers save 29% more time using programmatic guaranteed deals compared to traditional direct buying methods.
facts.quote: an oft-cited report from Boston Consulting Group finding that agencies and advertisers save 29% more time when using programmatic guaranteed deals compared to traditional direct buying methods.

facts.fact: According to a recent eMarketer report cited by the page, programmatic guaranteed helped make up a quarter of all CTV ad buys in 2024.
facts.quote: According to a recent report, programmatic guaranteed helped make up a quarter of all CTV ad buys in 2024.

facts.fact: Programmatic guaranteed is a type of direct deal in which a publisher agrees to sell a fixed number of impressions to an advertiser at a pre-negotiated price.
facts.quote: Programmatic guaranteed is a type of direct deal in which a publisher agrees to sell a fixed number of impressions to an advertiser at a pre-negotiated price.

facts.fact: A private marketplace (PMP) is an invite-only auction in which a select number of advertisers are invited to bid on premium inventory, and inventory in a PMP is not guaranteed.
facts.quote: A PMP is an invite-only auction in which a select number of advertisers are invited to bid on premium inventory.

facts.fact: With preferred deals, the buyer does not have to commit to purchasing a fixed number of impressions, unlike programmatic guaranteed deals.
facts.quote: Unlike programmatic guaranteed, the buyer doesn’t have to commit to purchasing a fixed number of impressions.

facts.fact: In an open auction (real-time bidding), there is no upfront commitment or pre-negotiated price, and inventory is sold impression by impression.
facts.quote: Unlike programmatic guaranteed, there’s no upfront commitment or pre-negotiated price. Instead, inventory is sold impression by impression

facts.fact: The article states that programmatic guaranteed is typically viewed as a complement to a media plan rather than a replacement for open auctions or other programmatic buying methods.
facts.quote: programmatic guaranteed is typically viewed as a complement to your overall media plan rather than a replacement for open auctions or other programmatic buying methods

facts.fact: The article states the publication date of the page as April 15, 2025.
According to EMARKETER, 76.2% of US programmatic digital display ad spending is expected to be transacted through programmatic direct channels by 2026.
facts.quote: with 76.2% of US programmatic digital display ad spending expected to be transacted through programmatic direct channels by 2026.

facts.fact: In a client-assisted programmatic guaranteed deal, a sales or account manager contacts the publisher to confirm availability and negotiate, using the client's campaign parameters and the publisher's rate card to determine cost and terms.
facts.quote: A sales or account manager then contacts the publisher directly to confirm availability and facilitate negotiations, using the client’s campaign parameters and the publisher’s rate card

facts.fact: In programmatic guaranteed deals where clients bring their own deals, the adtech platform uses a unique deal ID provided by the publisher to execute agreed terms and manage the campaign.
facts.quote: The platform uses a unique deal ID provided by the publisher to execute the agreed-upon terms and manage the campaign

facts.fact: The blog states that open auctions remain the most common buying method, while programmatic guaranteed is gaining momentum.
facts.quote: While open auctions remain the most common buying method, programmatic guaranteed is gaining momentum

facts.fact: EMARKETER says ad buyers are increasingly turning to PMPs and programmatic direct methods such as programmatic guaranteed, which both rely heavily on 1st-party data and offer access to premium inventory.
facts.quote: ad buyers are increasingly turning to PMPs and programmatic direct methods like programmatic guaranteed, which both rely heavily on 1st-party data and offer access to premium inventory
